desc: The Battle Arms Development Enhanced Nickel Teflon trigger assembly features smooth, precision-machined engagement surfaces and Nickel Teflon coating that removes the grittiness found in Mil-Spec triggers and provides a cleaner "break". This single-stage trigger is functionally similar to a standard Mil-Spec fire control group, but with noticeably cleaner, smoother, and more consistent operation. The trigger pull weight is within Mil-Spec tolerances, with a pull weight around 5.5-6 pounds.
